public/assets/js/vendor — third-party scripts loaded on demand (the pages' CSP allows only 'self').

qrcode.js   qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license (header inside the file). Draws the customer's pickup QR.
jsQR.min.js jsqr 1.4.0 by Cosmo Wolfe, Apache-2.0 (jsQR.LICENSE). Reads the QR from the camera when BarcodeDetector is missing.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.min.js
